vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nm-attune-project-planning
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle provides a comprehensive framework for project planning, architecture design, and task estimation. It defines a structured workflow that includes file mapping, dependency analysis, and sprint planning, with the final output saved to 'docs/implementation-plan.md'. While the instructions in SKILL.md direct the agent to automatically transition to an execution phase (attune:project-execution) without user confirmation, this is a documented feature of the Attune/Night Market workflow and does not involve data exfiltration, unauthorized access, or malicious code execution.

llm.summary: The visible artifacts show a benign instruction-only project-planning aid, with a disclosed note that fuller workflows may rely on separate skills or plugins.

dimensions.detail: The visible SKILL.md content is aligned with transforming specifications into phased plans, dependency analysis, sprint planning, and file-structure planning; it does not request code execution, credentials, or system access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill is mostly self-contained planning guidance, but it explicitly delegates comprehensive planning to another skill, so users should review that separate skill if used.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code in this package. The SKILL.md mentions an optional Claude Code plugin for a fuller experience, which is disclosed but outside the reviewed artifact set.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The metadata declares no required binaries, environment variables, credentials, config paths, or OS-specific capabilities, which is proportionate for an instruction-only planning skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The provided artifacts show no persistence mechanism, background execution, privilege escalation, credential use, or local data indexing.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This appears safe for ordinary project-planning use. If the assistant suggests using the referenced `spec-kit` skill or installing the Claude Code plugin, review those separately because they are outside this package. Assessment is based on the provided visible artifact text, which was partially truncated.

evidence.explanation: The skill discloses that fuller workflows may depend on another skill or plugin whose artifacts are not included in this review. This is purpose-aligned and not automatic, so it is a note rather than a concern.
evidence.snippet: For detailed task planning workflows, this skill delegates to `spec-kit:task-planning` as the canonical implementation... For the full experience with agents, hooks, and commands, install the Claude Code plugin.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review and approve the referenced `spec-kit:task-planning` skill or Claude Code plugin separately before relying on those expanded workflows.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If the assistant follows the referenced delegation or plugin suggestion, behavior may depend on separate artifacts with their own permissions and risks.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The only noted issue is disclosed reliance on external skills/plugins for fuller workflows; no automatic install or execution is shown.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account access, delegated privileges, or elevated permissions are requested in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No persistent memory, local data indexing, credential stores, or inter-agent data channels are shown.
